Puravankara Acquires Land for Rs 5,200 Crore Project in Greater Noida

Realty firm Puravankara has acquired a 13.44-acre land parcel in Greater Noida, marking its entry into the Delhi-NCR region. The project has a potential Gross Development Value (GDV) of Rs 5,200 crore. This move follows Oberoi Realty's recent debut in Gurugram, which generated Rs 8,109 crore in sales bookings from its first NCR project.
